question: Why is Gauss’s law useful for finding the electric field due to a continuous charge distribution with high symmetry? Give reason.

options.A: Gauss’s law is useful only for point charges and cannot be applied to continuous charge distributions
options.B: Gauss’s law gives electric field directly for any irregular charge distribution without using symmetry
options.C: Gauss’s law removes the need to know enclosed charge for continuous charge distributions
options.D: Gauss’s law simplifies field calculation when symmetry allows a suitable Gaussian surface, relating flux to enclosed charge
